title: [2.7] connection to pump get lost
symptom: During the day and night, after receiving a new BG value from the patched dexcom app, the pump connection gets lost. AAPS is still waiting for a result from the pump, new BG values come in but AAPS isn't activating a new connection and still waits for a not coming result. Exiting and restarting AAPS helps directly.
cause: Pump failed to set TBR and this state was not properly reported to loop tab.
evidence_quote: Pump failed to set TBR and this state was not properly reported to loop tab fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/6f7cfdd06dba07907a8dd4781182d12e9d4424b5
